Hi Natalia (and AP team),

- PDF emailed from billing@redwood.com (single-file PDF, invoice number in subject)
- Push to your AP portal (we can post PDF or XML via SFTP / API)
- e‑invoice webhook (structured XML/UBL delivered to your collector)

To keep things compliant for EU VAT and your internal controls, we also want to confirm: 
- Do you require the VAT certificate for Redwood as a sender proof? (we can attach it to first invoice)
- Is a purchase order required on every invoice? If yes, which PO field must match the invoice (PO number / cost center)?

Attached: sample invoice PDF (redwood_invoice_template_v1.pdf) and a redacted VAT cert placeholder.

We can adapt to whichever path you prefer, but need a short confirmation so our finance ops knows where and how to push.

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear options. Quick answers from AP:

- Preferred: portal push (SFTP) with PDF attachment. If you can provide XML (Peppol/UBL) later, we'd take that, but PDF via SFTP is fine to start.
- VAT certificate: yes, please attach a copy on your first invoice. We keep it in the vendor master file.
- PO requirement: we require a PO on invoices for amounts > €10k. For runs under that, no PO required but please include the project code (ST-91) in the invoice body.
- Authorization: our AP will accept invoices from billing@redwood.com once we have an onboarding email from your finance team confirming sender domain and bank account details. This is a standard fraud-control step.

I'll loop in the AP Team to coordinate SFTP credentials.

Regards,
